subject: Next steps — book 30-minute orientation; confirm stakeholders

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Blake <morgan.blake@helixapps.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@helixapps.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps — book 30-minute orientation; confirm stakeholders

Hi Morgan & Samir,

Thanks for the call earlier — good discussion on the latency targets and where Redwood could fit into HelixApps' inference pipeline. Quick recap and proposed next step: a focused 30-minute product orientation (not a deep workshop) primarily for your engineering + infra leads so we can show a short demo and validate integration approach.

Proposed 30-minute windows (all PDT):
- Option A: Wed 28 Oct, 10:00–10:30 AM (PDT) — best for east-coast PLs
- Option B: Thu 29 Oct, 1:00–1:30 PM (PDT) — aligns with your engineering sync
- Option C: Fri 30 Oct, 11:00–11:30 AM (PDT) — flexible if you need alternate folks

If none work, tell me two times that do. Also:
- Please confirm the stakeholders you'd like on this call (engineering, infra, security).
- Would you like us to record? We can keep it to the demo + 10 minutes for architecture Q&A.

I've attached a one‑page discovery summary and a short demo agenda to help stakeholders prep.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: discovery-summary.pdf, MVP-demo-agenda.pdf

Date: 2026-10-21T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — book 30-minute orientation; confirm stakeholders

Thanks Soojin — appreciative of the recap.

We can do Option B (Thu 29 Oct, 1:00 PM PDT). Please add our security lead Anita (anita.chawla@helixapps.com) and I'll also invite the infra manager (Samir is CC'd).

Recording is fine.

A couple quick asks for the orientation:
- Can the demo show a brief example of model routing/fallback behavior? That's a key gating item for us.
- Any pre-reads the infra team should skim? Prefer <5 minutes each.

We'll lock Option B once we have the calendar invite.

—Morgan
Morgan Blake
Head of Product, HelixApps

Recording enabled. Let me know if you'd prefer to include any additional slack/channel invites or a follow-up technical deep dive (we can schedule a 60–90m workshop with engineers after this if needed).

Best,
Soojin
